Casey Example

Developer Relations Lead, AI Infrastructure, Example Cloud

Editor's note: This post was updated after the product launch event.

The real challenge of building an agentic system isn't the construction, it's the measurement. Teams ship quickly and then struggle to say whether the agent is any better than last week.

A useful starting point is a small set of fixed tasks that the agent must complete every time the code changes, with each result scored by a person at first and by a model later on.

Over time the set grows to cover the failures seen in production, which keeps the measurement honest as the agent takes on harder work and new kinds of requests.
